intent.outcome: Design a website’s paginated results API and its database access.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Simulation stage 1 only, architecture detail level 2. Eight ordered synthetic records; one insert and one delete between pages. Cursor tokens are model JSON, not authenticated production cursors. Keyset uses binary search over a finite in-memory sorted index; snapshot copies model MVCC visibility, not a production database isolation proof.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.
